test_title: PYST 41: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 24 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.**

One’s family plays a very __major role to continue the trends__ and age-old traditions.

options.text: passive role in making the trends
significant role in enduring the trends

solution:
The correct answer is **'significant role in enduring the trends'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence points out the importance that a person's family has in maintaining familial trends and age-old traditions. 
 
• **Passive, futile **and **docile **give a meaning which implies that** the family** does not have a big role to play in **maintaining old traditions. **
 
• But, by using '**significant'**, this concept is established. 
 
• Hence, **option3 **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence__ -* ****One’s family plays a very **__significant role in enduring the trends__** and age-old traditions.*
